chunks: They said: "You know we have no need for your daughters, and know well what we want."

key_terms.بَنَاتِكَ: your daughters (referring to the progeny or descendants of the Prophet)

ai.seo_question: What did the people say to Prophet Hud when he called them to monotheism?
ai.summary: In this verse, the people of Hud (peace be upon him) acknowledge his prophetic status and divine knowledge but reject his call to monotheism, asserting their preference for their own desires and customs. This highlights a common theme in the Quran where recognition of truth does not necessarily lead to acceptance, as seen in the broader narrative of the prophets. The verse underscores the tension between divine guidance and human stubbornness, a recurring motif in the stories of the prophets.
